name: tailmouse-monorepo
description: TailMouse polyglot monorepo and spec-driven development harness

scripts.build: node tools/tailcat-gate.mjs build && node tools/build-native.mjs && pnpm --filter @tailmouse/web build && pnpm --filter @tailmouse/link-edge build
scripts.check:open-spec: openspec validate --all --strict --no-interactive && openspec schema validate tailmouse-sdd
scripts.coverage: pnpm --recursive --if-present run coverage && node tools/go-gate.mjs coverage
scripts.test:escape-network: node tools/tailcat-gate.mjs build && pnpm --filter @tailmouse/web build && go test -tags=tailcatintegration -count=1 -failfast -timeout=35m -run="TestImpairment|TestEscapeNetwork" ./apps/cli/internal/transport/tailcat
scripts.test:transport: node tools/tailcat-gate.mjs build && pnpm --filter @tailmouse/web build && go test -tags=tailcatintegration -count=1 -failfast -timeout=5m -run="^TestHermeticTailcat(Transport|ExpiredHost|ClientVerification)$" ./apps/cli/internal/transport/tailcat
scripts.web:recovery-build: pnpm web:recover-assets && pnpm --dir apps/web exec vite build --config vite.recovery.config.ts
